items.title: Meta stock jumps as Wells Fargo raises price target
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination to discuss Meta (META) more than 10% intraday surge after Wells Fargo (WFC) raised its price target on the stock from $640 to $796. Meta also got a boost from its Meta Muse AI agent app climbing to the top spot on Apple's (AAPL) App Store, highlighting growing momentum around the company's AI push.

items.title: Apple’s new iPhone Duo: Will consumers bite?
items.summary: Laffer Tengler Investments CEO and chief investment officer Nancy Tengler, Epistrophy Capital Research chief market strategist and The Drill Down podcast host Cory Johnson, and Slatestone Wealth partner Kenny Polcari join Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to break down the market for Apple’s (AAPL) new iPhone Duo. The panel discusses consumer deman and the competitive smartphone landscape.

items.title: SCHD’s 0.06% Fee Hides $413,350 in Decade-Long Underperformance on a $500,000 Position
